correctness.rationale: Direct character orthogonality gives the exact Fourier multiplication b_chi b_psi=b_{-chi} if psi=-2chi and zero otherwise. The rank of left multiplication by v=sum v_chi b_chi equals its number of nonzero coordinates, intrinsically preserved under automorphisms; hence every invertible automorphism permutes Fourier coordinate lines and is monomial. Matching all nonzero/zero products forces sigma commute with multiplication by 2 and −1 and c_0=1,c_{-chi}=c_chi^{-1},c_{2chi}=c_chi²; all conditions are reversible. H-orbits yield root factors mu_{2^(ell/2)+1} or mu_{2^ell−1}, and the centralizer of the H-set has wreath products (H/K) wr S_{r_K}. Independent exact prime p checks give orders 6,20,42,330,780,36992 for p=3,5,7,11,13,17. The odd-order restriction is essential to invertible doubling.
